[Compare plans & benefits > FAQs > What accounts are included in the $100,000 or $500,000 minimums?]

Almost all your Wealthsimple accounts are included! TFSAs, RESPs, RRSPs, GRSPs, LIRAs, and non-registered accounts — they’re all included, whether they’re Managed investing accounts or Wealthsimple Trade accounts. So are your Crypto, Save, and chequing accounts.
